attempts.summary: Configured 802.1Q tagged VLANs 10 and 20 over the shared eth1 link between node1, node2, and node3. node1 (OpenWrt) routes both VLANs via eth1.10 (192.168.10.1/24) and eth1.20 (192.168.20.1/24), each in its own firewall zone with forward=REJECT and no inter-zone forwarding rule. node2 (VLAN10, 192.168.10.11/24) and node3 (VLAN20, 192.168.20.12/24) each reach node1 as their gateway; direct traffic between node2 and node3 is actively refused by node1's firewall (ICMP Destination Port Unreachable), not silently dropped. All three nodes were individually restarted via native reboot, boot IDs changed confirming real restarts, and VLAN config/connectivity/isolation were verified intact after each restart.
